installed_variant_on_audited_unit.note: Observed on one unit only. Other lithium units may carry the AUO panel.

mechanism.value: Bootloader detects the panel and passes mdss_mdp.panel=<lk_cfg>:dsi:0:<node-name>; the kernel matches the DT node name. qcom,mdss-dsi-panel-id is not parsed by the downstream MDSS driver.

bootloader_detection_input.note: The 'lcd 3state id' string suggests a tri-state GPIO ID read with Sharp as the default fallback (inferred). The GPIO number and the ID-to-variant table were not recovered; aboot was not disassembled.

dt_default_panel.note: A8 DT default is an LG SW43101 panel, overridden at runtime by the bootloader command line. The DT default does NOT identify the lithium panel.

downstream_panel_id_property.note: Informational only; no reader in drivers/video/msm/mdss at the pinned commit. Values differ per variant.

panel_name.value: sharp fte716 1080p video mode dsi panel

derived.note: Arithmetic from the timings; downstream adds no extra blanking here.

reset_sequence.note: Pairs of <level ms>: high 10 ms, low 1 ms, high 10 ms.

status_read_command.note: No qcom,mdss-dsi-panel-status-command: ESD uses the TE signal, not a register read.

reset_gpio.note: TLMM gpio8. Polarity is not encoded (flags 0); the downstream driver drives the raw level from qcom,mdss-dsi-reset-sequence.

enable_gpio.note: TLMM gpio47 (disp_en_gpio): driven high before reset, low on off. Its electrical function (bias enable vs. other) is not documented.

backlight_enable_gpio.note: TLMM gpio48: driven high after the reset sequence, low on off.

te_gpio.note: TLMM gpio10, function mdp_vsync, 2 mA, pull-down.

vddr_gpio_regulator.note: Name implies a 1.6 V 'VDDR' rail (node name disp_vddr_vreg1_6); the voltage is not stated in DT (inferred). The FTE716 panel supply list does not reference it; it is held on through pinctrl output-high.

evidence.note: no vddr-supply in a8-msm8996-mtp.dtsi, msm8996-xiaomi-common.dtsi or msm8996-mdss.dtsi at the pinned commit

vddr_supply_on_dsi_ctrl.note: Present in all four stock lithium DTBs, absent from the pinned LineageOS source: the LineageOS tree is not byte-identical to the stock build.

panel_supplies.note: Enabled in list order vddio, lab, ibb; disabled in reverse (mdss_io_util.c msm_dss_enable_vreg). LAB/IBB are +/- rails; IBB is negative, the DT expresses magnitudes (inferred from qpnp-labibb naming).

touch_controller_coupling.note: In-cell touch shares LAB/IBB with the panel. mdss_panel_reset_skip_enable() is only called by Synaptics drivers, not ft5x46, so the LCD reset (gpio8) is owned by the display driver on lithium.

level_range.note: bl-min-level 1, bl-max-level 4095, brightness-max-level 4095 in both variants.

wled_parameters_stock.note: Values read from the stock DTB. Source agrees except qcom,en-phase-stag, which msm8996-xiaomi-common.dtsi sets and the stock DTB lacks (conflicting).

panel_side_brightness.value: On-commands send DCS 0x51 0xFF and 0x53 0x24 (BCTRL|BL on); brightness itself is WLED-controlled. The CABC hook writes DCS 0x55.

value: 1. msm_dss_enable_vreg: vddio (L14 1.8 V) on, sleep 1 ms; lab on; ibb on, sleep 10 ms
2. DSI link clocks on, controller sw reset; lanes at LP-11 (qcom,mdss-dsi-lp11-init)
3. pinctrl mdss_default (gpio8 out, gpio10 mdp_vsync, gpio40 output-high)
5. reset gpio8: high 10 ms, low 1 ms, high 10 ms (qcom,mdss-dsi-reset-sequence <1 10>,<0 1>,<1 10>)
7. send qcom,mdss-dsi-on-command in LP mode (dsi_lp_mode), batched by last flag
8. start video; WLED backlight set via bl_ctrl_wled
OFF: qcom,mdss-dsi-off-command in HS mode; gpio48 low; gpio47 low, 100 us; gpio8 low; pinctrl sleep; ibb off (5 ms pre), lab off, vddio off (10 ms pre)
With continuous splash active at first boot, steps 4-6 are skipped (panel already on).
power_sequence_downstream.note: Order derived from code paths, not from a captured trace. Not hardware validated.

splash_reservation.note: Fixed DT value in lithium's own stock DTBs and the live DT; not taken from scorpio.

reservation_overlap_check.note: Static regions in boot.img.dtb-5 only; dynamically allocated carve-outs (adsp/qseecom/secure) have no fixed reg and cannot be checked offline.

kernel_consumer.value: Downstream reads only base/size of the reservation from DT via qcom,cont-splash-memory/linux,contiguous-region; scan-out stays as programmed by the bootloader in MDP registers.

scanout_base.note: The reservation start is known; the address programmed into the MDP source pipe by aboot is not. aboot contains 0x83400000 as a 32-bit little-endian constant at 2 offsets (first 0xa0514) and no literal 0x83401000; meaning not established.

stride_bytes.note: Runtime value in MDP SSPP registers; not in DT.

pixel_format.note: Panel bpp is 24 (RGB888 on the DSI link); framebuffer memory format (r8g8b8 vs x8r8g8b8 etc.) is set by aboot and unproven.

dimensions.note: Panel active area; framebuffer geometry assumed equal but not proven.

size_bounds.note: Either candidate format fits; this does not choose one.

simple_framebuffer_recommendation.value: Do not add a simple-framebuffer node with guessed stride/format. Read MDP SSPP SRC0_ADDR/SRC_YSTRIDE0/SRC_FORMAT on stock (or let lk2nd report them) first.

evidence.note: no match for 'mipi_dsi_dcs_cmd' in include/ or drivers/gpu/drm/
no fte716/ft8716 driver; nearest FocalTech TDDI is panel-ebbg-ft8719.c (different panel)

labibb_binding.note: No PMI8994/PMI8996 LAB/IBB compatible in the pinned tree.

simple_framebuffer_binding.value: simple-framebuffer formats include r8g8b8, x8r8g8b8, a8r8g8b8
